title: Actual Expenses (Fiscal Year 2017)
description: Data Dictionary: Label Definition Definition Source Fund.Name The type of fund where the expenses are tracked. Office of Management and Budget Dept.Name The department associated with the expense. Office of Management and Budget Account.Name The account name as outlined in the City’s financial tracking system. Office of Management and Budget Total Amount The amount (in dollars) that the City spent on the expenditure. A negative number reflects an adjustment in the amount spent on the expenditure. Office of Management and Budget Period The period in which each revenue was recieved. Office of Management and Budget DepartmentGroup The department, agency, or category associated with the expense.
